items.title: DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion
items.brief: DoorDash is buying rival Instacart in a deal worth roughly $17 billion, signaling that the delivery wars continues to heat up.

items.title: Last snapshot of the US economy before midterms shows stronger growth but higher inflation
items.brief: The US economy continues to grow at a strong clip; however, fast-rising gas prices helped to lift inflation in September to a four-month high, new data showed Thursday.

items.title: Alaska Democrats just handed Trump a political gift
items.brief: Alaska Democrats gave Donald Trump exactly what he wanted.

items.title: AI hardware can be hacked so chatbots provide dangerous answers, research shows
items.brief: The hardware underpinning major AI models can be hacked so that chatbots provide faulty and dangerous answers to questions from users, according to new research shared exclusively with CNN.

items.title: Girl, 8, injured in wolf attack at German zoo
items.brief: An 8-year-old girl has been hospitalized after sustaining serious injuries in a wolf attack inside a German zoo’s enclosure .

items.title: Russia strikes Dnipro train station in central Ukraine, killing 13
items.brief: A Russian drone struck a train station in Dnipro, central Ukraine, Thursday morning, killing 13 people and injuring 10 others, authorities said.

items.title: Here are 5 things to know about NFL Week 8
items.brief: The NFL season is approaching its midway point, and the stakes are getting higher.

items.title: What caused the deadly train crash in Spain? What we know so far
items.brief: Scores of people were killed after two trains collided in Spain on Wednesday, in a crash that authorities say was caused by both computer system failure and apparent human error.
